description: Sync meeting transcripts from one Fireflies account, one searchable document per meeting with its AI overview.
opening: Sync meeting transcripts from one Fireflies account. Each meeting is one document with its title, Fireflies' AI overview and the transcript, each line labelled with its speaker.

Fireflies permissions are not imported, so every synced meeting is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Audio and video are not synced. Each sync reads meetings by meeting date, so a transcript or summary that changes later is not guaranteed to be picked up. Meetings deleted in Fireflies stay in HydraDB.

steps.title: Get an API key
steps.text: Get a Fireflies API key for the account whose meetings you want to sync.

steps.title: Select the account
steps.text: HydraDB lists one item for the whole account. Select it. You cannot pick individual meetings.

connect.account: One connector reads one Fireflies account.

sync.first_sync: Reads meetings from the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads meetings by meeting date, picking up meetings dated since the last sync.
sync.edits: A change to a meeting is picked up only if the meeting's date falls inside a later sync's window.
sync.deletes: Meetings deleted in Fireflies stay searchable in HydraDB.

documents.name: Meetings
documents.one_document: One meeting transcript. A meeting with no transcript sentences, no overview and no gist or short summary is skipped.
documents.title: The meeting title, or `Fireflies meeting <id>` when it has none.
documents.text: The meeting title, then the AI overview, then the transcript as one `Speaker: text` line per sentence. If there are no sentences and no overview, Fireflies' gist or short summary is used instead. The title is searchable too.
documents.files: None. Audio and video are not downloaded.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.text: Fireflies' AI overview, written before the transcript.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: The meeting time. Sets the result date and decides which meetings each sync reads. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.fireflies_id
attributes.text: The Fireflies transcript id. Picks out one meeting. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.host_email
attributes.text: The host's email. Limits a query to meetings one person hosted. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.organizer_email
attributes.text: The organizer's email. Limits a query to meetings one person organized. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.meeting_link
attributes.text: The conference link. Finds the meeting held at a given link. It does not link the meeting to Zoom or Google Calendar items. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.calendar_id
attributes.text: The calendar event id. Finds the transcript for a known calendar event. It does not link the meeting to Google Calendar items. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.participant_count
attributes.text: How many participant emails the meeting has. Limits a query by meeting size. Not searchable.

attributes.name: connector_id
attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's meetings. Not searchable.

attributes.name: host
attributes.text: The host's name, or email when no name was found. To find a host's meetings, filter on `additional_metadata.host_email`.

attributes.name: organizer
attributes.text: The organizer's name, or email when no name was found. To find an organizer's meetings, filter on `additional_metadata.organizer_email`.

attributes.name: participants
attributes.text: Participant emails. They are not attached to the meeting as people.

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.text: The same count as `additional_metadata.participant_count`, returned with the meeting.

attributes.name: sentence_count
attributes.text: How many transcript sentences were included.

attributes.name: action_items
attributes.text: Fireflies' AI action items. They are not part of the searchable text.

attributes.name: keywords
attributes.text: Fireflies' keyword labels. They are not part of the searchable text.

example_searches: What did we agree with Acme on last week's call?
What did Maria say about the migration timeline?
Give me the overview of yesterday's planning meeting.

connections: No links between meetings or to other tools. The calendar event id and conference link do not link a meeting to Google Calendar or Zoom items.
graph.people: The connector does not attach the host, organizer or participants to a meeting as people. Speaker names are part of the transcript text.
graph.from_text: The overview and the speaker-labelled transcript.

not_synced: The full attendee list Fireflies keeps. Only participant emails are kept.
Fireflies' AI outline and shorthand bullet summaries. Only the overview, action items, keywords and, as a fallback, the gist or short summary are kept.
Changes to older meetings whose date falls outside later syncs' windows.
Deletions: meetings deleted in Fireflies stay in HydraDB.
